name: The Obsidian Syndicate
goals: Monopolize black-market arcane relics and illicit contraband throughout the harbor.
description: A cutthroat syndicate of fence brokers, pickpockets, and shadow-dancers operating out of forgotten harbor cisterns.

clocks.title: Arcane Vault Infiltration
clocks.outcome: The Syndicate breaches the Highspire treasury and steals the Sun-Crest Amulet, sending the city into martial lockdown.

clocks.title: Black Market Shipment Arrival
clocks.outcome: A boatload of banned necrotic focus crystals lands at the docks unchecked.

name: Order of the Silver Gauntlet
goals: Purge supernatural corruption, stamp out smuggling, and enforce royal justice across the city wards.
description: An elite paladin and marshal military order dedicated to celestial law, order, and citizen safety.

clocks.title: Martial Sweep of the Sunken Ward
clocks.outcome: The Gauntlet places the lower docks under 24-hour curfew and arrests all suspected smugglers.

name: The Gilded Scales Consortium
goals: Maximize trade profits, control tariff exemptions, and secure new maritime shipping routes.
description: The wealthiest guild federation in the realm, governing trade pacts, banking, and precious metal assaying.

clocks.title: Buyout of Ironbound Foundries
clocks.outcome: Consortium secures majority stake in all weapon forges, raising gear prices by 25%.

name: Circle of the Pale Moon
headquarters: The Sunken Ward Catacombs / Tower of Mist
goals: Unearth forbidden Netherese artifacts and pierce the veil separating the Prime Material from the Shadowfell.
description: A secretive esoteric cabal of arcanists, necromancers, and occult scholars willing to sacrifice everything for cosmic insight.

clocks.title: Shadowfell Eclipse Awakening Ritual
clocks.outcome: A rift to the Shadowfell tears open beneath the city fountain, unleashing specters into the night.

name: The Ironbound Union
goals: Protect craftsmen wages, prevent noble exploitation, and defend working-class neighborhoods.
description: A rugged fraternal fellowship of blacksmiths, stonemasons, and dockworkers who stick together against tyrannical laws.

clocks.title: General Dockworkers Strike
clocks.outcome: Dockworkers shut down all cargo handling, stranding noble galleons in port.
